# speckit spec score

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Score one feature (`<feature>` accepts NNN, first bare integer, or first slug) or, with no argument, every feature — plus, enabled the unfiltered invocation, the governance/corpus sweeps and the project-health aggregate

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit spec score [OPTIONS] [FEATURE]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit spec score --help
```
